text: ok cool. how about clicking on existing pieces, and that sort of thing. also capturing the textures/materials that are applied. oh. lol. so, im trying to place a wall, i dont see anything pop up when i click or nor is there any false wall to show me the placement. but when i click the number of pieces total goes up. so it must be placing walls
resolution: Found and fixed the real bug behind 'placing walls but nothing shows (no ghost, no placed wall) though the count goes up': rectRef in IsoAuthor was never set from layout (stuck at 0,0,800x600), so GAME_CAMERA.screenRay got the wrong screen rect AND treated the mouse's absolute coords as pane-local — every ground pick resolved to garbage world coords, so walls committed off-screen (some of the earlier 'floating junk' was these mis-placed walls) and the ghost was out of view. Fix: set rectRef from the root Box onLayout. That one fix makes placement, the ghost, selecting existing pieces (raycast), and zoom-to-cursor all use the correct rect. Also added a cursor-FOLLOWING ghost: the host fires no passive hover-move events (on_mouse_move only during a drag, engine.zig:4277), so the translucent preview is now driven by polling getMouseX/Y in the per-frame loop while a piece is armed, re-snapping only when the target cell changes. Remaining sub-item from the same message: mounting TextureCapture so SKINNED pieces show their applied materials (default-colour pieces already render); will do next. Bundles clean (esbuild exit 0).
